base_solution_anchor.base_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m."XCL_011" = '+' THEN m."XCL_010" ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT m."XCL_010") FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m."XCL_010" = a."XCL_002" INNER JOIN bond AS b ON m."XCL_010" = b."XCL_005" WHERE b."XCL_006" = '=' AND a."XCL_003" IN ('pb', 'br')

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = 'carcinogenic' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.XCL_010 IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT b.XCL_005
  FROM bond b
  WHERE b.XCL_006 = '='
)
AND m.XCL_010 IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_002
  FROM atom a
  WHERE a.XCL_003 IN ('pb', 'br')
)
